title: EXIF viewer and remover: photo metadata and GPS location
description: See what's hidden in a photo — camera, date taken, settings and GPS location — and remove metadata from JPEGs without re-compressing before you share them.

ui.notJpeg: Viewing and lossless removal work for JPEG. For PNG and WebP, re-save the file with the image converter — metadata isn't carried over.
